title: Penguin dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="92" rx="22" ry="4" fill="#2a1a4a"/>
  <!-- left foot -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="88" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#ff8c42"/>
  <!-- right foot -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="86" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#ff8c42"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="28" fill="#4a4a8a"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="14" ry="20" fill="#c8d8ff"/>
  <!-- left flipper waving up -->
  <path d="M28 54 Q14 38 20 26 Q26 20 32 30 Q36 40 33 52 Z" fill="#6a6aaa"/>
  <!-- right flipper waving up -->
  <path d="M72 52 Q86 36 80 24 Q74 18 68 28 Q64 38 67 50 Z" fill="#6a6aaa"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="32" r="18" fill="#4a4a8a"/>
  <!-- white face patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#c8d8ff"/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="31" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="30" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <circle cx="57" cy="31" r="3.5" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="30" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d="M46 39 L50 46 L54 39 Z" fill="#ffb347"/>
  <!-- cheeks blush -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#ff88aa" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#ff88aa" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="60" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#e8f0ff" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- little bow tie -->
  <path d="M44 50 L50 53 L56 50 L56 54 L50 51 L44 54 Z" fill="#ff5a8a"/>
</svg>
